import statistics

# Given data
data = [
    {"year": "2003", "sales": None, "cost_of_goods_sold": None},
    {"year": "2004", "sales": 62.4976, "cost_of_goods_sold": 39.1213},
    {"year": "2005", "sales": 77.6731, "cost_of_goods_sold": 50.5783},

]
